optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Procurement Operations Specialist, Insurance Claims Platform

professionalSummary.text: Procurement Operations Specialist with 3+ years of end-to-end ownership of insurance claims supplier panels, including tender cycles, performance reviews, and rate documentation within delegated authority.
professionalSummary.witness: Responsibilities included tender file preparation, performance-pack compilation, proposal collation and end-of-cycle documentation for the claims supplier panel over about three years.

professionalSummary.text: Proven ability to prepare tender files, compile performance data, and document panel changes with clear accountability boundaries.
professionalSummary.witness: Prepared the tender file for the regional repair and inspection panel: supplier questionnaires, the scoring template and the comparison sheet that the procurement manager and the claims director used in the award meeting. Compiled quarterly supplier performance packs from claims cycle-time and complaint data and presented them at the review meeting, where the procurement manager decided on warnings or removals. Wrote the end-of-cycle note after each tender, listing suppliers still under probation, open contract clauses and the hand-over items for the contract administrator.

experienceHighlights.text: Led tender cycle execution for repair and inspection panels, including preparation of tender files with scoring templates and comparison sheets used by senior leadership in award decisions.
experienceHighlights.witness: Prepared the tender file for the regional repair and inspection panel: supplier questionnaires, the scoring template and the comparison sheet that the procurement manager and the claims director used in the award meeting.

experienceHighlights.text: Compiled and presented quarterly supplier performance packs using claims data, directly informing performance review outcomes.
experienceHighlights.witness: Compiled quarterly supplier performance packs from claims cycle-time and complaint data and presented them at the review meeting, where the procurement manager decided on warnings or removals.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented end-of-cycle handover items and panel status, ensuring clear accountability boundaries for panel changes.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the end-of-cycle note after each tender, listing suppliers still under probation, open contract clauses and the hand-over items for the contract administrator.
